## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: A structural-boundary test suite asserts the db-case markers exist in the actual producer file (task-decomposer.md), with awk section-scoping and a section-missing guard, registered in the repo-root .test-index.

## Implementation
Create tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh — a structural-boundary suite asserting the reserved `db` case in plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md contains every required db-case marker. Model on tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-remediation.sh: use awk to scope assertions to the `db` case section only (markers elsewhere must not satisfy a clause), and include a section-missing guard that FAILS with a clear diagnostic if the db-case section header is absent (no vacuous pass on an empty awk range).

The suite MUST assert all FOUR clauses of the db-case prose, each a separately named assertion:
- clause a: BOTH task-types present — rollback migration AND rollback-verification.
- clause b: classification tokens `safe-revert` and `compensating-forward` present, plus the `DATA LOSS RISK` ambiguity-default annotation.
- clause c: the rollback-verification done-definition asserts on SCHEMA STATE (post-rollback schema assertion wording), not merely command exit 0.
- clause d (dd-1 three-task): the db-case prose describes emitting the THREE tasks (forward migration + rollback + rollback-verification) as a CO-AUTHORED unit. Assert (within the awk-scoped db section) forward-migration co-authoring wording — so a prose edit that only adds rollback tasks "alongside existing forward migrations" FAILS this clause.

Register the suite in the REPO-ROOT .test-index by APPENDING it to the existing plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md line (so the line maps the producer to BOTH test-task-decomposer-remediation.sh and the new test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh). chmod +x the new file. The suite is RED now (db-case markers absent) and goes GREEN once task-2 lands; RED again on revert.

## TDD Test Spec
Given the reserved db case in plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md before its prose is filled; When tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh runs (awk-scoped + section-missing guard); Then it FAILS on each of the four named clauses (a/b/c/d) because the markers are absent, and PASSES on all four only after task-2 fills the db-case prose.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New suite exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh
- [ ] Suite is awk section-scoped and carries a section-missing guard
  Verify: grep -q 'awk' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh && grep -qiE 'section.*(missing|absent|not found)' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh
- [ ] Suite registered in repo-root .test-index on the task-decomposer.md line alongside the remediation suite
  Verify: grep -F 'plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md' .test-index | grep -F 'tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh'
- [ ] Suite asserts clause d (forward-migration three-task co-authoring) as a distinct named assertion
  Verify: grep -iE 'forward' tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh | grep -iE 'co-author|three-task|triple|same plan'
- [ ] Suite is RED against the current (unfilled) task-decomposer.md
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-db-case.sh; test $? -ne 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add structural-boundary suite asserting db-case markers in task-decomposer.md
